01Technical Interviews · S20 · Guide 1 / 5

How do SQL Joins Work?

1. JOIN kya hai? — do list milana

Do list socho — ek me student ke naam, dusri me unke marks. Dono ko roll number se milana hai — kaun se student ke kitne marks? Yehi JOIN hai: do table ko common column se jodna.

JOIN ke 4 type is baat pe depend karte hain: kaun si row rakhni hai — dono me common wali, ya ek side ki saari, ya dono side ki saari.

Yaad rakhne ka tareeka: Venn diagram socho — INNER = beech ka hissa (common), LEFT = left circle poora + common, RIGHT = right circle poora + common, FULL = dono circle poore.

2. 4 joins — ek-ek karke

INNER JOIN — sirf common row

Dono table me common row hi aati hai — jiska match dono taraf hai. Match nahi hai to row gayab.

SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
-- Sirf wo user jinhone order kiya hai

Best hai: "kinhone order kiya?" — sirf matching data chahiye.

LEFT JOIN — left table ki saari row

Left table ki saari row aati hai — match mile to right ka data, nahi mile to NULL. Sabse zyada use hone wala join.

SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
-- Saare user, order ho to total, nahi to NULL
-- "kinhone order NAHI kiya?" -> WHERE o.id IS NULL

Sahi: "saare user dikhao, order ho to bhi" — LEFT JOIN.

RIGHT JOIN — right table ki saari row

Right table ki saari row aati hai — left ka match mile to data, nahi to NULL. LEFT JOIN ka ulta hai — table ka order badal do to LEFT JOIN ban jata hai.

SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
RIGHT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
-- Saare order, user ho to naam, nahi to NULL

Note: interview me RIGHT JOIN kam poochte hain — LEFT JOIN se kaam chal jata hai.

FULL OUTER JOIN — dono table ki saari row

Dono table ki saari row aati hai — match mile to ek saath, nahi mile to dusri taraf NULL. "Sab kuch dikhao" wala join.

SELECT u.name, o.total
FROM users u
FULL OUTER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id;
-- Saare user + saare order, match ho to saath

Galat: MySQL me FULL OUTER JOIN nahi hota — LEFT + RIGHT ko UNION se karna padta hai.

Bonus: CROSS JOIN — har row × har row

Har row ka har row se combination — 100 user × 100 product = 10,000 row. Bina ON condition ke hota hai.

Use: combination banana (jaise size × color).

Danger: badi table pe CROSS JOIN matlab crore row — galti se bhi mat chalana.

3. JOIN andar se kaise kaam karta hai?

Database JOIN ko 3 tareeke se chalata hai — optimizer data dekh ke chunta hai:

AlgorithmKaiseKab best
Nested LoopEk row lo, dusri table me dhoondhoChhoti table, index hai
Hash JoinEk table ka hash banao, dusri se match karoBadi table, no index
Merge JoinDono sorted hain to saath-saath chalaoDono sorted, badi table
-- JOIN slow hai? Check karo:
-- 1. Join column pe index hai? (user_id pe index)
-- 2. EXPLAIN me Nested Loop + Seq Scan dikh raha hai?
--    -> Hash Join ya index chahiye
-- 3. JOIN se pehle filter karo (WHERE pehle, JOIN baad me)

4. 4 joins ek table me

JoinKya aata haiUse karo jab
INNERSirf commonMatch chahiye
LEFTLeft saari + matchLeft ki saari row chahiye
RIGHTRight saari + matchRight ki saari row chahiye
FULLDono saariSab kuch chahiye
CROSSHar × harCombination chahiye

5. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  1. LEFT JOIN ki jagah INNER JOIN likhna — row gayab ho jayengi, pata bhi nahi chalega.
  2. Join column pe index na lagana — Nested Loop + Seq Scan se query crawl.
  3. CROSS JOIN galti se chalana — crore row ban jayenge.
  4. JOIN ke baad WHERE ki jagah ON me filter karna (LEFT JOIN me) — result alag aayega.
  5. NULL handle na karna — LEFT JOIN me right side NULL aata hai, code me check karo.

6. Interview corner

Q: "INNER aur LEFT JOIN me kya farak hai?"
A: INNER me sirf common row aati hai — match nahi to row gayab. LEFT me left table ki saari row aati hai — match nahi to right side NULL. "Saare user dikhao" ke liye LEFT, "sirf order wale user" ke liye INNER.

Q: "JOIN slow kyun hota hai?"
A: Join column pe index nahi ho, ya galat join algorithm chun liya gaya ho. Fix: join column pe index lagao, EXPLAIN se plan dekho, aur WHERE se pehle filter karo.

Q: "MySQL me FULL OUTER JOIN kyun nahi hota?"
A: MySQL FULL OUTER JOIN support nahi karta — LEFT JOIN aur RIGHT JOIN ko UNION se karna padta hai. PostgreSQL me hota hai.

Ek line me yaad rakh lo: INNER = common, LEFT = left saari, RIGHT = right saari, FULL = dono saari — Venn diagram yaad rakho.

Sourcehttps://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/how-do-sql-joins-work.md

02Technical Interviews · S20 · Guide 2 / 5

What Happens When You Type google.com Into a Browser?

1. Ek Enter ke peeche kya hota hai? — chitthi wali kahani

Tum chitthi likhte ho — "Google, mujhe homepage do". Pehle pata dhoondhna padta hai (DNS), phir rasta banana padta hai (TCP), phir lifafa seal karna padta hai (TLS), phir chitthi bhejni hai (HTTP), phir jawab aata hai, aur phir use padh ke dikhana hai (rendering). Har step me kuch na kuch ho raha hai.

Ye sawaal har interview me aata hai kyunki isme poora internet aa jata hai — DNS, networking, security, browser — sab ek sawaal me.

Yaad rakho: ye 30 step millisecond me hote hain — isliye page 1 second me khulta hai. Koi ek step slow ho to poora page slow.

2. Step by step — Enter se page tak

Step 1 — URL parse aur cache check

Browser URL ko parse karta hai — protocol (https), domain (google.com), path (/). Phir check karta hai: cache me page hai? HSTS list me hai? Agar cache me fresh copy hai to aage kuch nahi — seedha dikha do.

Step 2 — DNS: naam se IP nikalo

google.com ka IP address chahiye. Browser pehle apna cache, phir OS cache, phir resolver (8.8.8.8), phir root → TLD → authoritative server se poochta hai. Jawab: 142.250.x.x.

Slow ho to: DNS prefetch aur DNS cache se bachate hain — pehli baar slow, baad me tez.

Step 3 — TCP connection aur TLS handshake

IP mil gaya to TCP handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK) — connection banta hai. Phir TLS handshake — certificate check, encryption key exchange. Ab baat encrypted hai.

HTTP/2 ya HTTP/3 pe ek hi connection pe kai request ja sakti hain — multiplexing se tez hota hai.

Step 4 — HTTP request bhejo

Browser HTTP request bhejta hai: GET / HTTP/1.1 + headers (User-Agent, Accept, Cookie). Server (Google ka load balancer) use sahi server pe bhejta hai.

Step 5 — Server pe kya hota hai

Google ka server request padhta hai, homepage banata hai (search box, doodle, language), aur HTTP response bhejta hai — status 200, headers, HTML body. CDN se static file (logo, JS) bhi aate hain.

Step 6 — Browser page banata hai

Browser HTML ko parse karke DOM banata hai, CSS se CSSOM, dono se render tree, phir layout aur paint. JS chalta hai, image load hote hain — page dikhta hai.

Slow ho to: bada JS, bina optimize image, ya render-blocking CSS — page late dikhega.

3. Poora flow — ek diagram jaisa

  1. Tum Enter dabate ho
  2. URL parse → cache check
  3. DNS lookup: google.com → 142.250.x.x
  4. TCP handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK)
  5. TLS handshake (certificate + encryption)
  6. HTTP GET / → Google server
  7. Server: load balancer → web server → response
  8. Browser: HTML parse → DOM + CSSOM → render → paint
  9. Google homepage dikha!

Time kahan jata hai? DNS (~20–50ms), TCP+TLS (~50–100ms), server (~50–200ms), rendering (~100–500ms). Total ~1 second — aur har step ko optimize karke 300ms tak la sakte hain.

4. Har step ka time — ek table me

StepTimeSlow hone ka fix
DNS20–50msDNS prefetch, cache
TCP20msKeep-alive, HTTP/2
TLS50msTLS 1.3, session resume
Server50–200msCDN, cache, fast backend
Rendering100–500msChhota JS, optimize image

5. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  1. "Browser seedha server se baat karta hai" bolna — beech me DNS, TCP, TLS, load balancer sab hain.
  2. DNS ko ignore karna — pehli baar ka page slow aksar DNS ki wajah se hota hai.
  3. HTTP aur HTTPS ko ek samajhna — TLS handshake extra step hai, security ke liye.
  4. Rendering ko bhoolna — server tez ho to bhi bada JS page ko slow kar dega.
  5. Cache ko ignore karna — dobara visit pe cache se page instant khulta hai.

6. Interview corner

Q: "google.com type karne pe kya hota hai?"
A: URL parse → DNS lookup (IP nikalo) → TCP handshake → TLS handshake → HTTP request → server processing → response → browser rendering (DOM, CSSOM, paint). Har step millisecond me hota hai.

Q: "DNS kya hai?"
A: Domain name ko IP address me badalne wala system — jaise phone book. Browser cache, OS cache, resolver, root, TLD, authoritative — is order me poochta hai.

Q: "TLS handshake kyun hota hai?"
A: Connection ko encrypt karne ke liye — certificate verify karta hai ki server asal me Google hai, aur encryption key exchange karta hai taaki beech me koi padh na sake.

Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Enter → DNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP → server → rendering — 1 second me poora internet.

Sourcehttps://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/what-happens-when-you-type-google.md
Pichla01. How do SQL Joins Work?Agla03. What Happens When You Type a URL Into Your Browser?
03Technical Interviews · S20 · Guide 3 / 5

What Happens When You Type a URL Into Your Browser?

1. URL ka safar — detail me

Pehle wale guide me tumne overview dekha — yahan har step ko aur deep me samjho: DNS kaise kaam karta hai, TCP ke packet kya hote hain, TLS me kya exchange hota hai, aur browser page ko kaise paint karta hai.

Interview me is sawaal ka jawab level se diya jata hai — pehle overview (5 step), phir interviewer poochhe to deep (har step ka andar). Ye page dono level deta hai.

Interview trick: pehle 30 second me overview bolo — DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP, rendering. Phir interviewer jis step pe roke, uspe deep jao. Ye page wahi deep detail deta hai.

2. Har step — deep me

DNS — deep me

DNS hierarchical hai: Root (.) → TLD (.com) → Authoritative (google.com). Har level pe cache hota hai — browser, OS, resolver, ISP. TTL (time-to-live) batata hai cache kitni der chalega.

Record types: A (IPv4), AAAA (IPv6), CNAME (alias), MX (mail). google.com ka A record IP deta hai.

Sahi: DNS prefetch se pehle hi IP nikal lo — page load tez.

TCP — deep me

TCP reliable hai — packet kho jaye to dobara bhejta hai. 3-way handshake: SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK. Phir data segment me banta hai, har segment ka sequence number hota hai.

Congestion control: slow start se shuru, phir speed badhata hai — network ko overload nahi karta.

TLS — deep me

TLS 2 kaam karta hai: authentication (certificate se server verify) aur encryption (symmetric key se data encrypt). TLS 1.3 me handshake 1 round trip me ho jata hai — pehle 2 lagte the.

Certificate: CA (Certificate Authority) sign karta hai — browser check karta hai ki certificate valid hai aur domain match karta hai.

HTTP — deep me

HTTP request me method, path, headers, body hota hai. HTTP/1.1 me ek connection pe ek request, HTTP/2 me multiplexing (kai request ek saath), HTTP/3 me QUIC (UDP pe, tez handshake).

Response: status code (200, 301, 404, 500), headers (Content-Type, Cache-Control), body (HTML).

Rendering — deep me

Browser critical rendering path follow karta hai: HTML → DOM, CSS → CSSOM, dono → render tree → layout (kahan dikhega) → paint (kaise dikhega) → composite.

JS: parser ko rokta hai — isliye script ko defer ya end me lagate hain. CSS: render-blocking hai — isliye critical CSS pehle, baaki baad me.

Load Balancer — beech me kaun hai?

Google ke paas ek server nahi, lakh server hain. Request pehle load balancer pe aati hai — wo health check karke sahi server chunta hai (round-robin, least connection, geo-based).

Anycast: ek hi IP duniya bhar me — request sabse paas ke data center pe jati hai. Isi liye Google har jagah tez khulta hai.

3. Ek user ka example — original guide se

Ek user URL type karta hai aur Enter dabata hai. Us URL ke 4 hisse hote hain:

  • scheme — http:// — browser ko batata hai HTTP se server se baat karni hai.
  • domain — example.com — site ka domain name.
  • path — product/electric — server pe resource ka path.
  • resource — phone — jo resource chahiye uska naam.

Browser pehle domain ka IP address DNS lookup se nikalta hai. Lookup tez karne ke liye data alag-alag layer pe cache hota hai: browser cache, OS cache, local network cache, aur ISP cache. Agar kisi bhi cache me IP nahi mila to browser DNS server se recursive DNS lookup karta hai jab tak IP na mil jaye.

IP milne ke baad browser server se TCP connection banata hai, phir HTTP request bhejta hai. Request aisi dikhti hai:

GET /phone HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com

Server request process karke response bhejta hai. Successful response (status code 200) aisi dikhti hai:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date: Sun, 30 Jan 2022 00:01:01 GMT
Server: Apache
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
Hello world
</html>

Phir browser HTML content ko render karta hai.

4. Interview me kaise bolo — 30 second, 2 minute, 10 minute

TimeKya bolo
30 secDNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP → Rendering
2 minHar step ek line: DNS (cache, hierarchy), TCP (handshake), TLS (certificate), HTTP (request/response), Rendering (DOM, paint)
10 minHar step deep: DNS record type, TCP congestion, TLS 1.3, HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, critical rendering path, load balancer, CDN

Common follow-up: "DNS slow ho to kya karoge?" — prefetch, cache, TTL badhao. "Page slow ho to kya karoge?" — JS chhota karo, image optimize karo, CDN lagao, critical CSS pehle do.

5. HTTP version ek table me

VersionKya nayaSpeed
HTTP/1.1Keep-alive, ek request ek baarSlow (head-of-line blocking)
HTTP/2Multiplexing, header compressionTez
HTTP/3QUIC (UDP), 0-RTT handshakeSabse tez

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  1. Sirf "DNS → server" bolna — TCP, TLS, rendering bhoolna.
  2. HTTP aur HTTPS ko ek samajhna — TLS extra step hai.
  3. Rendering ko ignore karna — server tez ho to bhi page slow ho sakta hai.
  4. Load balancer aur CDN ko bhoolna — Google ek server nahi hai.
  5. Cache ko ignore karna — dobara visit pe sab cache se hota hai.

7. Interview corner

Q: "URL type karne pe kya hota hai?"
A: Overview: DNS lookup → TCP handshake → TLS handshake → HTTP request → server processing → browser rendering. Deep: DNS hierarchy, TCP 3-way handshake, TLS 1.3, HTTP/2 multiplexing, critical rendering path.

Q: "HTTP/2 HTTP/1.1 se tez kyun hai?"
A: Multiplexing — ek connection pe kai request parallel chalti hain, bina head-of-line blocking ke. HTTP/1.1 me ek connection pe ek request hoti thi.

Q: "Critical rendering path kya hai?"
A: HTML → DOM, CSS → CSSOM, render tree → layout → paint → composite. JS parser ko rokta hai, CSS render-blocking hai — isliye script defer karo aur critical CSS pehle do.

Ek line me yaad rakh lo: URL ka safar hai DNS → TCP → TLS → HTTP → rendering — pehle overview bolo, phir deep jao.

Sourcehttps://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/what-happens-when-you-type-a-url-into-your-browser.md

04Technical Interviews · S20 · Guide 4 / 5

How to Ace System Design Interviews

1. System design interview kya hai? — ghar banane wali kahani

Architect se ghar banane ko kaho to wo pehle poochta hai — kitne log rahenge? budget kya hai? zameen kaisi hai? Phir sketch banata hai, phir detail me jata hai — kamre, bijli, paani. Seedha deewar banana shuru nahi karta. System design interview waisa hi hai — pehle samjho, phir design karo.

Interviewer tumse perfect system nahi mangta — wo dekhta hai ki tum requirement samajhte ho, trade-off bolte ho, aur scale ka andaza lagate ho.

Golden rule: interview me bolte raho — chup reh ke sochna sabse badi galti hai. Apni soch ko loud bolo, interviewer guide karega.

2. 7-step framework — har question pe

Step 1 — Requirements Clarification (5 min)

Poochho: user kaun hai? kitne user? read ya write heavy? kya feature chahiye? Scope decide karo — kya banana hai, kya nahi.

Example: "URL shortener banao" — poochho: kitne URL/day? custom alias chahiye? expiry chahiye? analytics chahiye?

Galat: bina pooche design shuru kar dena — galat system bana doge.

Step 2 — Capacity Estimation (5 min)

Hisab lagao: kitne user, kitni request/sec, kitna storage, kitni bandwidth. Back-of-envelope math — exact nahi, order of magnitude chahiye.

Example: 100M URL/day → ~1000 write/sec. Har URL 100 byte → 10GB/day → saal me 3.6TB.

Step 3 — High-Level Design (10 min)

Box aur arrow banao: client → load balancer → app server → DB → cache → queue. API likho — kaun si endpoint, kya input/output.

Example: POST /shorten → short URL do. GET /abc123 → redirect karo.

Step 4 — Database Design (10 min)

Table/schema likho — kaun si table, kaun se column, kaun sa index. SQL ya NoSQL? — data aur query se decide karo.

Example: urls (short_key, long_url, created_at, user_id) — short_key pe index.

Step 5 — Interface Design (API)

API contract likho — endpoint, method, request, response, error. Idempotency aur rate limiting bhi socho. Communication approach chuno: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, ya event-driven.

Step 6 — Scalability and Performance (10 min)

Scale kaise karein: cache (Redis), CDN, read replica, sharding, queue, load balancer. Bottleneck kahan hoga? Pehle kya todega?

Example: hot URL ke liye cache, read ke liye replica, write ke liye sharding.

Step 7 — Reliability and Resiliency (5 min)

Fail hone pe kya hoga: server down, DB down, network partition. Failover, retry, circuit breaker, backup — ye sab bolo. Single point of failure pehchano aur uska impact kam karo.

Example: DB replica se failover, queue se retry, CDN se static file.

3. Back-of-envelope math — yaad rakhne layak numbers

CheezNumber
1 day~100,000 seconds (10^5)
1M request/day~12 request/sec
1B request/day~12,000 request/sec
1 char1 byte
1M user × 1KB1 GB storage
Network (datacenter)~1ms, 1 Gbps
Disk seek~10ms (HDD), 0.1ms (SSD)
Memory~100ns

Trick: 10^5 second/day yaad rakho — 1M/day = 10/sec, 100M/day = 1000/sec. Interview me yehi kaafi hai.

4. 7 steps ek table me

StepTimeKya karna hai
1. Requirements5 minPoochho, scope decide karo
2. Capacity5 minBack-of-envelope hisaab
3. High-level design10 minBox-arrow, API
4. Database10 minSchema, SQL/NoSQL
5. Interface5 minAPI contract
6. Scale10 minCache, replica, sharding
7. Reliability5 minFailover, retry, backup

5. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  1. Bina requirement pooche design shuru karna — galat system banega.
  2. Chup reh ke sochna — interviewer tumhari soch nahi dekh payega.
  3. Perfect system dhoondhna — trade-off bolo, perfect nahi hota.
  4. Capacity estimation skip karna — scale ka andaza nahi hoga.
  5. Database pehle chunna — data aur query pehle, DB baad me.

6. Interview corner

Q: "System design interview me kya dekhte hain?"
A: Requirement samajhna, trade-off bolna, scale ka andaza, aur communication. Perfect system nahi — soch ka tareeka dekhte hain.

Q: "Back-of-envelope estimation kyun karte hain?"
A: Scale ka andaza lagane ke liye — kitne server, kitna storage, kitni bandwidth chahiye. Exact number nahi, order of magnitude chahiye.

Q: "URL shortener kaise design karoge?"
A: Requirements poochho, capacity nikalo (100M/day → 1000/sec), high-level design (LB → App → DB + Cache), DB schema (short_key, long_url), scale (Redis cache, replica), reliability (failover).

Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Pehle poochho, phir hisaab lagao, phir design karo — bolte raho, trade-off bolo, perfect mat dhoondho.

Sourcehttps://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/blob/main/data/guides/how-to-ace-system-design-interviews-like-a-boss.md

05Technical Interviews · S20 · Guide 5 / 5

Recommended Materials for Technical Interviews

1. Interview prep — roadmap wali kahani

Interview ki taiyaari exam ki taiyaari jaisi hai — syllabus pata ho to padhna easy hai. Bina roadmap ke tum har jagah thoda-thoda padhoge, aur kuch bhi deep nahi hoga. Ye page roadmap deta hai — kya, kis order me, aur kitna time.

Guide ke hisaab se 6 area hain: Coding, System Design, Behavioral, OOD, Mock Interview, aur Apply karna. Har ek ka apna material aur apna time hai.

Rule: ek area ko deep karo, phir agle pe jao. Har jagah thoda-thoda padhna sabse badi galti hai.

2. 6 areas — ek-ek karke

Coding — DSA ki taiyaari

Kya: Array, string, linked list, tree, graph, DP — pattern seekho, question ratna nahi.

Material: LeetCode (150–200 question kaafi hain), NeetCode roadmap, Grokking patterns.

Practice: roz 2–3 question, time limit me. Bol ke solve karo — interview me bolna padta hai.

System Design — framework seekho

Kya: 7-step framework (requirements → capacity → design → DB → API → scale → reliability).

Material: ByteByteGo, Designing Data-Intensive Applications, System Design Primer (GitHub).

Practice: URL shortener, Twitter, WhatsApp, Netflix — har ek ko framework se design karo.

Behavioral — kahani sunao (STAR)

Kya: "mushkil project", "team me ladai", "deadline miss" — inke jawab STAR format me taiyaar rakho: Situation, Task, Action, Result.

Material: Apne 5–6 best project ki kahani likh lo — har ek me tumhara role aur result saaf ho.

OOD — Object Oriented Design

Kya: Parking lot, elevator, chess — class diagram banao, design pattern lagao (Singleton, Factory, Observer).

Material: Grokking OOD, Refactoring Guru (design pattern).

Mock Interview — asli jaisi practice

Kya: dost ya mentor se mock interview do — time limit, whiteboard, bol ke solve karna. Feedback lo — kahan atke, kya bhool gaye.

Material: Pramp, interviewing.io, ya dost ke saath mock.

Apply — job kaise dhoondhein

Kya: Resume 1 page, har point me number (impact dikhao). Referral maango — cold apply se 10x behtar hai.

Material: LinkedIn, referral, aur company ki job page — har jagah apply karo, ek jagah nahi.

4. Prep roadmap — 8 hafte ka plan

HaftaFocusKya karna hai

3–4Coding advancedTree, graph, DP — 50 question

6. Common galtiyan — ye 5 mat karna

  1. Har jagah thoda-thoda padhna — kuch bhi deep nahi hoga.
  2. Sirf question ratna — pattern seekho, interview me naya question aayega.
  3. Bol ke practice na karna — interview me bolna padta hai, chup reh ke nahi hota.
  4. Mock interview skip karna — asli interview me time aur pressure alag hota hai.
  5. Resume me kaam likhna, impact nahi — number dikhao (10x tez, 50% kam cost).

7. Interview corner

Q: "Interview ki taiyaari kaise karein?"
A: Roadmap: coding (LeetCode pattern), system design (7-step framework), behavioral (STAR kahani), OOD, aur mock interview. Roz 2 ghante, 8 hafte — consistency sabse important hai.

Q: "STAR format kya hai?"
A: Behavioral jawab ka format: Situation (kya hua), Task (tumhara kaam), Action (tumne kya kiya), Result (kya hua). Har kahani me tumhara role aur number saaf ho.

Q: "System design kaise seekhein?"
A: Framework seekho (requirements → capacity → design → DB → scale → reliability), phir 5–6 classic design practice karo — URL shortener, Twitter, chat, Netflix.

Ek line me yaad rakh lo: Roadmap lo, ek area deep karo, roz practice karo — consistency hi selection dilati hai.

07Technical Interviews · S20

FAQs — interview sawaal

Interview me sabse zyada pooche jaane wale 12 sawaal — sawaal dabao, jawab khulega.

Q1google.com type karne pe browser ke andar kya-kya hota hai?
URL parse aur cache check, phir DNS lookup se IP nikalna (browser cache, OS cache, resolver, root, TLD, authoritative), phir TCP 3-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK), phir TLS handshake (certificate verify + encryption key), phir HTTP request, server processing (load balancer se sahi server), aur aakhir me browser rendering (HTML se DOM, CSS se CSSOM, render tree, layout, paint). Sab millisecond me hota hai — total lagbhag 1 second.
Q2DNS kya hai aur ye kaise kaam karta hai?
DNS domain name ko IP address me badalne wala system hai — jaise phone book. Browser pehle apna cache, phir OS cache, phir resolver (jaise 8.8.8.8) se poochta hai. Resolver root server, phir TLD server (.com), phir authoritative server se pooch kar IP nikalta hai. Har level pe cache hota hai aur TTL batata hai cache kitni der chalega. DNS prefetch se pehle hi IP nikal kar page load tez kiya ja sakta hai.
Q3INNER JOIN aur LEFT JOIN me kya farak hai?
INNER JOIN me sirf wo row aati hain jinka match dono table me hai — match nahi to row gayab ho jati hai. LEFT JOIN me left table ki saari row aati hain — match mile to right ka data, nahi mile to right side NULL. 'Saare user dikhao' ke liye LEFT JOIN, 'sirf order wale user' ke liye INNER JOIN. 'Kinhone order NAHI kiya' nikalne ke liye LEFT JOIN + WHERE order IS NULL use karte hain.
Q4MySQL me FULL OUTER JOIN kyun nahi hota?
MySQL FULL OUTER JOIN support nahi karta. FULL OUTER JOIN dono table ki saari row deta hai — match ho to saath, nahi to dusri taraf NULL. MySQL me ye kaam LEFT JOIN aur RIGHT JOIN ko UNION se karke karna padta hai. PostgreSQL me FULL OUTER JOIN seedha support hota hai. Interview me ye poochha jata hai ki tumhe pata ho kaun sa database kya support karta hai.
Q5System design interview ka pehla step kya hota hai?
Requirements Clarification — bina pooche design shuru mat karo. Poochho: user kaun hai, kitne user hain, read heavy hai ya write heavy, kya feature chahiye, kya scope hai aur kya nahi. Jaise 'URL shortener banao' pe poochho: kitne URL/day, custom alias chahiye, expiry chahiye, analytics chahiye. Scope decide karne ke baad hi capacity estimation aur design shuru karo.
Q6Back-of-envelope estimation me 1M request/day kitne request/sec hote hain?
1 din me lagbhag 10^5 second hote hain (100,000). 1M request/day ko 10^5 se bhaag do to ~10-12 request/sec milte hain. 100M/day ka matlab ~1000 request/sec aur 1B/day ka matlab ~12,000 request/sec. Interview me exact number nahi, order of magnitude chahiye — 10^5 second/day yaad rakho to har hisaab 10 second me ho jata hai.
Q7HTTP/2 HTTP/1.1 se tez kyun hai?
HTTP/1.1 me ek connection pe ek request hoti thi — agla request pehle wale ka intezar karta tha (head-of-line blocking). HTTP/2 me multiplexing hoti hai — ek hi connection pe kai request parallel chalti hain, aur header compression bhi hota hai. HTTP/3 aur aage jata hai — QUIC protocol (UDP pe) se 0-RTT handshake, matlab connection aur bhi tez banta hai.
Q8Critical rendering path kya hai?
Browser ka page banane ka rasta: HTML parse karke DOM, CSS parse karke CSSOM, dono se render tree, phir layout (kahan dikhega), paint (kaise dikhega), aur composite. JavaScript parser ko rokta hai — isliye script ko defer karo ya page ke end me lagao. CSS render-blocking hoti hai — isliye critical CSS pehle do aur baaki baad me. Bada JS ya bina optimize image page ko slow kar deta hai.
Q9Behavioral interview me STAR format kya hai?
STAR ka matlab hai Situation, Task, Action, Result. Koi bhi behavioral sawaal — 'mushkil project', 'team me ladai', 'deadline miss' — ka jawab is format me do: Situation (kya hua), Task (tumhara kaam kya tha), Action (tumne kya kiya), Result (kya hua, number ke saath). Apne 5-6 best project ki kahani pehle se STAR me likh lo, har ek me tumhara role aur result saaf ho.
Q10TCP 3-way handshake kyun zaroori hai?
TCP reliable connection banane ke liye 3-way handshake karta hai: client SYN bhejta hai, server SYN-ACK se jawab deta hai, client ACK se confirm karta hai. Isse dono side ko pata chal jata hai ki dusra side sun raha hai aur sequence number kya honge. Iske baad data segment me banta hai, har segment ka sequence number hota hai — packet kho jaye to dobara bheja jata hai. Isi reliability ki wajah se TCP web traffic ke liye use hota hai.
Q11Browser cache miss hone pe IP address kaise nikalta hai?
Browser pehle apna cache check karta hai, phir OS cache, phir resolver (jaise 8.8.8.8) se poochta hai. Resolver root server se TLD server ka pata, TLD se authoritative server ka pata, aur authoritative se aakhir me IP nikalta hai — ise recursive DNS lookup kehte hain. Har level pe cache hota hai, isliye pehli baar slow aur dobara visit pe tez hota hai. DNS prefetch se IP pehle se nikala ja sakta hai.
Q12Technical interview ki 8 hafte ki taiyaari kaise baantein?
Hafta 1-2 coding basics (array, string, hash map — 50 question), hafta 3-4 coding advanced (tree, graph, DP — 50 question), hafta 5-6 system design (7-step framework + 5 design), hafta 7 behavioral aur OOD (STAR kahani + 3 OOD design), hafta 8 mock interview (5 mock, feedback, revise). Roz 2 coding question (1 ghanta) + 1 system design topic (1 ghanta) + revise (30 min). Ek din 10 ghante se behtar hai roz 2 ghante — consistency hi selection dilati hai.

Kya isme nahi hai (out of scope)

  • Data Structures & Algorithms ki gehrai — coding round ke algorithm aur unki practice is part me nahi hai; yahan sirf interview strategy aur system design pe focus hai.
  • Live coding / mock interview — asli mock interview ka experience ya code likhne ki practice is page se nahi milegi; ye samajhne ke liye hai, practice alag se karni hogi.
  • Behavioral round ki poori taiyaari — STAR format samjhaya gaya hai, lekin har company ke behavioral sawaal aur unke jawab yahan nahi hain.
  • Salary negotiation aur offer process — offer, negotiation aur joining process is part ke bahar hai.
  • Company-specific interview process — alag-alag company ke round aur unke pattern yahan cover nahi hain.
  • Resume / portfolio review — resume kaise likhein, is par is part me kuch nahi hai.
